page: Microsoft Azure NC64as_T4_v3 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance within the NCASv3_T4 family, powered by Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Built on 64 dedicated x86_64 AMD vCPUs, the system incorporates 440 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered by four NVIDIA T4 GPUs offering a combined 64 GB of GPU VRAM, alongside 3024 GB of integrated local SSD storage with Premium Storage capability.

The architecture pairs high vCPU density and expansive system RAM with multi-GPU acceleration. With four dedicated NVIDIA T4 accelerators, the configuration supplies specialized tensor and graphics processing hardware suitable for parallelized processing tasks without relying solely on host CPU compute. Storage architecture includes 3024 GB of local temporary SSD space, though the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured networking resources or private endpoints for external connectivity.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the NC64as_T4_v3 offers high resource density by packing 64 AMD cores, significant host memory, and four enterprise inferencing GPUs onto a single instance, optimizing compute-per-dollar for multi-stream AI workloads compared to deploying multiple smaller instances. This profile fits production machine learning inference, distributed graphics rendering, video transcode pipelines, and data-intensive compute workloads requiring simultaneous high memory capacity and GPU acceleration.
description: Microsoft Azure NC64as_T4_v3 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine from the NCASv3_T4 family, engineered for parallel compute and machine learning tasks. It is configured with 64 dedicated x86_64 AMD vCPUs, 440 GB of system RAM (6.88 GB per core), and 3024 GB of local SSD storage supported by Microsoft Hyper-V with Premium Storage capability. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA T4 GPUs providing an aggregate 64 GB of VRAM. The combination of dense multicore CPU resources, high-capacity system memory, and quad-GPU acceleration creates a balanced environment for scale-out parallel pipelines while avoiding multi-instance networking overhead. The server does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This instance profile is targeted at deep learning inference, video transcoding, visual computing, and large-scale data analytics workloads requiring concurrent GPU processing and substantial memory capacity.
